correctness.rationale: The ternary digit characterization proves the aligned coarse block pattern at every scale; two zero-run maximality arguments certify the first two phrase lengths, and uniqueness of the two possible length-3q copies of C_j forces the only candidate source for a longer third phrase, contradicted by its next symbol. Valid earlier sources are exhibited in all three cases. The scales tile [8q,24q), and finite truncation yields exactly 3k phrases. Independent direct brute-force parsing of actual C_k passed for 0<=k<=7; finite checks support, not replace, proof.
